proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA) Practitioners
proposals.buyer_persona: Adults (20-45) practicing historical sword fighting. They read ancient manuals (fechtbuchs), respect historical accuracy, and spend heavily on protective gear and swords.
product_angles: Highly accurate vector graphic apparel featuring manual illustrations (Meyer, Talhoffer) with clean modern typography
KDP Training Logbooks specifically formatted for sparring notes, weapon maintenance, and tournament tracking
Stickers with insider HEMA jokes ('Right of Way is for cowards', 'Zwerchhau solves everything')
proposals.first_test_product: HEMA Sparring Logbook & Technique Tracker on Amazon KDP

proposals.name: Retro PS1-Style (PSX) Indie Game Developers
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo indie game developers building low-poly retro horror or boomer shooter games. They hang out on Itch.io, Reddit (r/retrodev), and Twitter/X.
product_angles: 64x64 and 128x128 pixelated/dithered seamless texture packs (grunge metal, old brick, sci-fi panels)
Low-poly UI asset packs (retro health bars, pixel fonts, memory card icons)
Sound effect packs generated or processed to mimic 16-bit / early CD-ROM audio limitations
proposals.first_test_product: PSX Retro Horror Seamless Texture Pack (64 textures) on Itch.io

proposals.name: Geotechnical Engineers & Soil Mechanics Professionals
proposals.buyer_persona: Civil engineers specializing in foundations, dirt, rock, and drilling. They love hyper-specific technical humor regarding Karl Terzaghi, shear strength, SPT blow counts, and mud.
product_angles: Redbubble apparel with technical soil mechanics Mohr's circle diagrams turned into jokes
Engineering graph paper notebooks with customized geotechnical reference sheets on the inside covers
Stickers for hard hats featuring industry-specific humor ('Trust me, I know my dirt')
proposals.first_test_product: Geotechnical Hard Hat Sticker Pack on Redbubble

proposals.name: TTRPG Fantasy Cartographers (Wonderdraft/Inkarnate Users)
proposals.buyer_persona: Dungeon Masters and fantasy authors who design custom maps for their worlds. They buy custom asset brushes (mountains, trees, castles) to use in mapping software.
product_angles: Custom transparent PNG asset packs of hand-drawn style fantasy medieval buildings and castles
Seamless paper and parchment texture packs for map backgrounds
Pre-made vector map labels, banners, and compass roses
proposals.first_test_product: Hand-drawn Medieval Settlement Asset Pack (transparent PNGs) on Etsy & Itch.io

proposals.name: Amateur Radio (Ham Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Mostly older tech-savvy hobbyists obsessed with radio frequencies, antennas, Morse code, and international contacts. They take pride in their callsigns and log every contact.
product_angles: Highly structured KDP Ham Radio Logbooks (UTC, Frequency, Mode, Power, RST columns)
Apparel with Morse code patterns of famous phrases or technical jokes about SWR (Standing Wave Ratio)
Customizable QSL card templates (cards sent to confirm radio contact) sold as digital downloads
proposals.first_test_product: Premium amateur radio operator logbook on Amazon KDP

proposals.name: Local Craft Breweries (French Micro-brasseries)
proposals.buyer_persona: Independent craft brewers in France who lack in-house graphic designers. They need professional, legally-compliant label templates and localized merchandise designs.
product_angles: Beer label templates formatted for standard bottles/cans, editable in free Canva accounts
Localized merchandise graphics (t-shirts, coasters) combining regional heritage with craft beer culture
Social media post templates designed specifically for craft beer announcements and taprooms
proposals.first_test_product: Pack of 5 Editable Craft Beer Label Templates (Canva link) sold on Etsy
